statement: Let visit_sum(S) = the sum of c_i over all i with 0 <= i < n such that S is a label-boundary suffix of D_i (a label-boundary suffix of a domain L1....Lk is L_j....Lk for some 1 <= j <= k). Let E be the set of byte strings decimal_repr(visit_sum(S)) ++ [32] ++ S, over all domain strings S that are a label-boundary suffix of at least one D_i. The function returns a result r and r is a permutation of E: len(r) = |E|, every entry of r belongs to E, and every member of E occurs exactly once as an entry of r. The order of entries is arbitrary.
preconditions: Let n = len(cpdomains). 1 <= n <= 100. For each i with 0 <= i < n, cpdomains[i] is the byte string decimal_repr(c_i) ++ [32] ++ D_i, where 1 <= c_i <= 10^4, decimal_repr(c_i) is the usual decimal representation with no leading zero, [32] is one ASCII space, D_i is a dot-separated domain string with at least 2 nonempty lowercase ASCII letter labels and no other bytes, and len(cpdomains[i]) <= 100.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, every entry e of r has the form decimal_repr(c) ++ [32] ++ D for a unique integer c >= 0 and a unique domain string D, and c = the sum of c_i over all i with 0 <= i < n such that D is a label-boundary suffix of D_i (a label-boundary suffix of L1....Lk is L_j....Lk for some 1 <= j <= k).
